issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Rideable.messageOnRide: The problem statement UML and exercise text declare a no-argument method messageOnRide(): String (and the provided Main template calls r.messageOnRide() with no arguments). The solution repository defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and both Pig and Seal implement messageOnRide(String equipment). This signature mismatch (no-arg vs one-arg) will cause compilation errors for students following the problem/template and is a real inconsistency between the specification/template and the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across all artifacts. Recommended: change the solution to declare Rideable.messageOnRide() with no parameters and update Pig and Seal to implement a no-arg messageOnRide() that returns "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]" (removing the equipment parameter). Alternatively, if the equipment parameter is intentional, update the problem statement UML and the Main template to accept and pass a String equipment argument to messageOnRide(String equipment) and document the parameter.
